mini_widget_docking_hint: Drag the pin near a screen edge to dock immediately. Side edges show apps from top to bottom with volume indicators, with the pin facing the screen interior. Scroll to adjust volume; click to mute. Drag away to restore the horizontal view.
mini_widget_show_master: Show master volume first in mini widget
drag_app_tooltip: Hold the left mouse button and drag to reorder
invalid_application_drop: Drop a local .exe file or a Windows shortcut (.lnk) to an existing application.
mini_widget_show_above_taskbar: Show mini widget above the taskbar
language_guide_copy: 1. In the project source, copy sound_mixer/i18n/en/strings.json into a folder named with the Windows language code, for example sound_mixer/i18n/de/strings.json or sound_mixer/i18n/pt-BR/strings.json.
language_guide_translate: 2. Translate the values in this UTF-8 JSON file, keeping the keys unchanged. Missing entries automatically use English.
language_guide_build: 3. Rebuild with python build.py. The language appears automatically in Settings. To share your translation, submit the file to the project on GitHub.
drop_app_here: Drag & drop an application or shortcut here
subprocess_management_toggle_tooltip: Actively rescan for sub-processes spawned by sandboxed/launcher tools (uses more resources while on)
app_feedback: The author collects suggestions for improvements in the Issues section on GitHub.
guide_mini_scroll_desc: Adjust that application's volume and select it for mini widget hotkeys independently of the main widget
guide_mini_click_desc: Toggle mute for that application and select it for mini widget hotkeys independently of the main widget
guide_mini_hover_desc: Reveal the pin used to move the widget
guide_mini_drag_desc: Hold the left mouse button to move the widget; its position is saved
guide_mini_dock_desc: Dock while dragging near an edge; side edges show apps vertically with the pin toward the screen interior
guide_mini_undock_desc: Use the pin to undock and restore the horizontal layout
guide_drag_desc: Set volume to an exact level
guide_mute_click_desc: Toggle mute on / off for that application
guide_arrows_volume_desc: Decrease / increase the focused application's volume
guide_hotkey_toggle_desc: Toggle overlay visibility from any application
guide_hotkey_mini_desc: Toggle the compact application volume widget
guide_hotkey_mini_focus_desc: Cycle through visible entries while the mini widget is shown; system volume participates only when displayed
guide_hotkey_mini_volume_desc: Adjust the selected entry by the keyboard step while the mini widget is shown; the first entry is selected initially
guide_hotkey_mini_master: Mini widget: Show / Hide system volume
guide_hotkey_mini_master_desc: Toggle and save system volume visibility, even when the mini widget is hidden; all mini widget shortcuts start unassigned
guide_hotkey_vol_desc: Adjust the focused application's volume without opening the overlay
guide_hotkey_focus_desc: Move focus while the overlay is hidden
guide_hotkey_mute_desc: Toggle mute for the focused application
